paragraphs.en: {Narrator}: Two rich brothers, Roderick and Oliver, have made a {bet}. Oliver believes that with a million-pound bank note a man could live a month in London. His brother Roderick doubts it. They see a poor young man walking outside their house. It is Henry Adams.
paragraphs.cn: 旁白：富有的两兄弟，罗德里克和奥利弗，打了一个赌。奥利弗认为，凭一张百万英镑的钞票，一个人能在伦敦生活一个月。他的兄弟罗德里克对此表示怀疑。他们看见一个穷困的年轻人在房外走着。那是亨利·亚当斯。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: Young man, would you step inside a moment, please?
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：年轻人，请进来一会儿，好吗？

paragraphs.en: Henry: Who? Me, sir?
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：谁？我吗，先生？

paragraphs.en: Roderick: Yes, you.
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：是的，你。

paragraphs.en: (A {servant} opens a door.)
paragraphs.cn: （一个仆人打开门。）

paragraphs.en: {Servant}: Good morning, sir. Would you please come in?
paragraphs.cn: 仆人：早上好，先生。请进，好吗？

paragraphs.en: (Henry enters the house.)
paragraphs.cn: （亨利走进屋子。）

paragraphs.en: Henry: Thank you.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：谢谢。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: How do you do, Mr ... er ...?
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：你好，先生，你贵姓？

paragraphs.en: Henry: Adams. Henry Adams.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：亚当斯。亨利·亚当斯。

paragraphs.en: Oliver: Come and sit down, Mr Adams.
paragraphs.cn: 奥利弗：来，坐下吧，亚当斯先生。

paragraphs.en: Henry: Thank you.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：谢谢。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: You're an American?
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：你是美国人？

paragraphs.en: Henry: That's right, from San Francisco.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：是的，从旧金山来。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: May we ask what you're doing in this country and what your plans are?
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：可不可以问问，你在这个国家干什么，有什么打算？

paragraphs.en: Henry: Well, I can't say that I have any plans. As a matter of fact, I landed in Britain by accident.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：嗯，谈不上有什么计划。事实上，我是偶然来到英国的。

paragraphs.en: Oliver: How is that possible?
paragraphs.cn: 奥利弗：这怎么可能呢？

paragraphs.en: Henry: Well, I had my own boat. About a month ago, I was sailing, and towards night I found myself carried out to sea by a strong wind. The next morning I was spotted by a ship.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：嗯，我以前自己有艘船。大约一个月前，我驾船出海，临近夜晚时，一阵强风把我刮到了海上。第二天早晨，一艘船发现了我。

paragraphs.en: Oliver: And it was the ship that brought you to England.
paragraphs.cn: 奥利弗：正是那艘船把你带到了英国。

paragraphs.en: Henry: Yes. I went to the American {consulate} to seek help, but ... Anyway, I didn't {dare} to try again. (The brothers smile at each other.)
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：是的。我去美国领事馆寻求帮助，但是……总之，我不敢再去试了。（兄弟俩相视而笑。）

paragraphs.en: Roderick: Well, you mustn't worry about that. It's an advantage.
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：嗯，你不必为此担心。这倒是个优势。

paragraphs.en: Henry: I'm afraid I don't quite follow you, sir.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：先生，恐怕我不太明白你的意思。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: Tell us, what {sort} of work did you do in America?
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：告诉我们，你在美国是做什么工作的？

paragraphs.en: Henry: I worked for a {mining} company. Could you offer me work here?
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：我在一家矿业公司工作。你们能在这儿给我份工作吗？

paragraphs.en: Roderick: {Patience}. If you don't mind, may I ask you how much money you have?
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：别急。如果你不介意的话，我能问问你有多少钱吗？

paragraphs.en: Henry: Well, to be honest, I have none.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：嗯，说实话，我一分钱也没有。

paragraphs.en: Oliver: (happily) What luck! Brother, what luck!
paragraphs.cn: 奥利弗：（高兴地）真走运！兄弟，真走运！

paragraphs.en: Henry: Well, it may seem lucky to you but not to me! If this is your idea of some kind of joke, I don't think it's very funny. Now if you'll excuse me, I ought to be on my way.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：嗯，对你们来说也许走运，但对我可不是！如果你们把这当成某种玩笑，我觉得一点也不好笑。那么，失陪了，我该走了。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: Please don't go. You mustn't think we don't care about you. Oliver, give him the letter.
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：请别走。你千万别以为我们不在意你的感受。奥利弗，把信给他。

paragraphs.en: Oliver: Yes, I was about to go get the letter. Wait! (getting it from a desk and giving it to Henry) The letter.
paragraphs.cn: 奥利弗：好，我正要去拿信。等等！（从书桌上拿起信递给亨利）信。

paragraphs.en: Henry: (taking it carefully) For me?
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：（小心翼翼地接过信）给我的？

paragraphs.en: Roderick: For you. (Henry starts to open it) Oh, no, you'd better not open it. You can't open it until two o'clock.
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：给你的。（亨利开始拆信）哦，不，你最好别拆。两点钟以前你不能拆开它。

paragraphs.en: Henry: Oh, this is silly.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：哦，这真荒唐。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: Not silly. There's money in it.
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：不荒唐。里面有钱。

paragraphs.en: Henry: Oh, no. I don't want your charity. I just want a job that earns an honest income.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：哦，不。我不要你们的施舍。我只想要一份能挣得正当收入的工作。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: We know you're hard-working. That's why we've given you the letter. (to the {servant}) Show Mr Adams out.
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：我们知道你工作努力。正因为如此我们才把信给你。（对仆人）送亚当斯先生出去。

paragraphs.en: Oliver: Good luck, Mr Adams.
paragraphs.cn: 奥利弗：祝你好运，亚当斯先生。

paragraphs.en: Henry: Well, why don't you explain what this is all about?
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：嗯，你们为什么不解释一下这到底是怎么回事？

paragraphs.en: Roderick: You'll soon know. In exactly an hour and a half.
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：你很快就会知道的。确切地说，一个半小时以后。

paragraphs.en: {Servant}: This way, sir.
paragraphs.cn: 仆人：这边请，先生。

paragraphs.en: Roderick: Not until 2 o'clock. Promise?
paragraphs.cn: 罗德里克：两点以前不准拆。能保证吗？

paragraphs.en: Henry: Promise. Goodbye.
paragraphs.cn: 亨利：保证。再见。
